Use case: stylized-concept. Original modular arm-and-hand game assets for Echoes of Dante Organic Sci-Fi R3. Input image is ONLY the project's approved Warrior costume/paint reference: pale ivory/sage manufactured ceramic field armor, charcoal woven flexible undersuit, muted orange harness marks, rounded painted material volume, restrained warm edge wear, upper-left lighting. Create a transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows, SIX isolated parts centered in equal cells with wide transparent gutters.
TOP row left to right:
0 ONE upper arm sleeve, horizontal, shoulder on LEFT to elbow on RIGHT. Compact gently rounded human bicep armor over dark fabric, visible inner elbow seam, no shoulder pad (already on torso), no other body part.
1 ONE forearm sleeve, horizontal, elbow LEFT and wrist RIGHT. Tapering compact ivory forearm guard, dark flexible elbow, dark charcoal cuff on right, small orange equipment mark, no hand.
2 ONE gloved HUMAN HAND clenched around an INVISIBLE HORIZONTAL sword handle. Palm/inner grip three-quarter view. Wrist enters from LEFT, fingers curl around center, thumb wraps naturally, separated readable curled finger shapes, charcoal flexible glove, small ivory knuckle protection and orange trim. No sword or pole drawn. Hand approximately square and clearly a closed gripping hand, not an open hand or mitten.
BOTTOM row, left to right:
3 BACK/OUTER VIEW of matching upper arm sleeve, same endpoints LEFT shoulder to RIGHT elbow. Outer pale bicep guard and protected elbow seam; subtle structural/material differences from cell 0 so the rear view is distinct.
4 BACK/OUTER VIEW of matching forearm sleeve, same LEFT elbow to RIGHT wrist. Outer arm guard, dark cuff, readable painted volume, consistent manufactured field gear.
5 BACK/DORSAL VIEW of same clenched gloved hand holding INVISIBLE horizontal handle, wrist from LEFT. Show protective ivory knuckle plates, dark finger joints and wraparound thumb, not palm.
Arms are HUMAN proportions, compact, no robotic pistons, no metal tubes, no mechanical ball joints. These are articulated parts of one living sci-fi explorer, not independent limbs flying. The two gloves should be substantially more material and anatomical than circles used as old game hands.
Whole parts in frame, uniform scale per matching part across top/bottom views. Broad painted masses, no huge triangular facets, no flat SVG look, no black heavy ink outlines. No duplicate parts, no text, labels, cell borders, weapon, torso, helmet, legs, scenery, floor, cast shadow or haze. TRUE transparent alpha zero everywhere outside parts. Output game-quality original painted raster parts.

Use case: stylized-concept. An original ENERGY SABER weapon cutout for Echoes of Dante Organic Sci-Fi R3. Input sheet is ONLY the matching character's manufactured material and illustration style reference. ONE isolated two-handed human sci-fi field saber, seen in a slightly elevated side view, perfectly HORIZONTAL: handle/pommel LEFT, straight blade points RIGHT. Hand-painted rounded volumes and practical worn equipment, matte ivory/sage emitter casing, charcoal textured grip, brushed muted gunmetal, tiny orange industrial hardware markings, subtle material scuffs. No ornamental fantasy symbols.
Weapon proportions: from left to right 28% is physical handle/emitter and 72% is luminous energy blade. Two-handed charcoal cylindrical grip has readable finger grooves and enough length for two gloved hands, compact buttcap. A small asymmetric emitter/guard wraps the base of the energy blade, not a gigantic crossguard. Grip lies on EXACT same horizontal axis as blade core.
Blade: readable cyan #5fe6d8 energy with pale near-white center, soft rounded contained light edge, slightly tapering to RIGHT tip. Not a wireframe triangle and no black outline around energy. No geometric mesh, crystal or physical medieval steel blade. Keep glow restrained and tightly around blade so silhouette is readable at 90–100 game pixels. Soft upper-left light on solid manufactured handle, no bloom clouds.
Entire weapon horizontal centered with clear transparent margins, no perspective diagonal, no second item, no hand or arm, no character, no inscription, no labels, no grid, no text, no ground or cast shadow. TRUE transparent alpha outside object/glow. A painted 2D production game asset, not vector art, not photograph, not a screenshot. Original sci-fi equipment design compatible with the input costume.
